request.text: Rank the warehouse packers by speed and show a leaderboard of who packed the fewest boxes today.

feasibility.concern: Rank the warehouse packers by speed and show a leaderboard of who packed the fewest boxes today.
feasibility.says: I cannot accept this request: Per-person productivity tracking, rankings, and individual idle tracking are prohibited.
feasibility.alternative: We can measure station throughput, queue wait times, or process cycle times at equipment/stations without attributing metrics to individuals.
feasibility.reason: Per-person productivity tracking, rankings, and individual idle tracking are prohibited.
